description: core's HUD shell corpus (conformance/ui/notifications-cases.json, P2.core) through the ui.notifications.* rows, each op the calls core's reference runner (src/ui/hud-corpus.ts) makes, through them; numbers held exactly (the corpus's tolerance is 1e-9; tests/ui_hud_corpus.cpp replays the file itself within it), but for a step declared as a library-version answer.

cases.name: ui-notifications: the contract ui.notifications.contract states
ui-notifications toasts: push with no kind or lifetime is info, the accent colour, for the default lifetime
ui-notifications toasts: each kind maps to its token colour
ui-notifications toasts: ids start at 1 and count up; the queue is oldest first
ui-notifications toasts: tick expires the shorter lifetime and reports the change
ui-notifications toasts: a toast whose remaining time reaches exactly 0 expires
ui-notifications toasts: a toast just short of 0 stays, and nothing changed
ui-notifications toasts: ticks accumulate until the lifetime is spent
ui-notifications toasts: tick on an empty queue reports no change
ui-notifications toasts: tick of 0 with toasts showing reports no change
ui-notifications toasts: a lifetime of 0 shows until the next tick, even a tick of 0
ui-notifications toasts: dismiss removes by id; an unknown or already dismissed id removes nothing
ui-notifications toasts: clear empties the queue but does not reset the id counter
ui-notifications history: push stamps the id (from 0) and the clock, and keeps the fields it was given
ui-notifications history: absent optional fields stay absent
ui-notifications history: every category is carried as given
ui-notifications history: recent(n) is the newest n, newest first
ui-notifications history: recent(n) beyond the stored count returns them all, newest first
ui-notifications history: recent(0) is empty
ui-notifications history: all() is the whole log, newest first; length counts it
ui-notifications history: the log keeps 200, evicting the oldest first
ui-notifications history: exactly 200 evicts nothing
ui-notifications history: clear empties the log but does not reset the id counter
